EmailTemplate.subject: ITA - FAQ Pending TAME Updates
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName}
Thank you for contacting Insperity Time & Attendance Support. This item in the MEC indicates that an administrator at the client site has scheduled a Time Assignment change through Premier > Manage Employees. No action is needed on your end; as long as the status is still set to 'New,' the change will automatically be pushed through to Time & Attendance once the effective date aligns with the active pay period in AIMS containing that date. Once payroll processing is complete for pay periods prior to the noted effective date, this item will finish processing through the MEC automatically.
If you have additional questions or concerns, please let us know and we will be happy to help.
Thank you,
Technical Support Team
